text_block_list.text:
One evening, we're walking through the
shopping
district after a street
performance, when...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oh, look, Trainer! Something's going on
over
there!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Step right up and try your luck with our
New
Year's raffle! This year's grand prize
is a hot
spring vacation for two!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot
hamburger
steak! Second-prize winners
get a bushel of
carrots! And third-prize
winners can take home a
single carrot!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Don't let this opportunity pass you by!
Get a
ticket now and spin for your
chance to win!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text: Aha... I see what's happening here.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: This is a test.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: A test of my Umadol stardom!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
You know how I got a raffle ticket with
that
dessert earlier? Just a single ticket...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: In other words...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
This is totally a test to see if I can get
the grand
prize with just one chance!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: The Stardom Goddess!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
At any rate! When an Umadol is tested,
we just
have to prevail!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I'm going to prove that I'm the best
vessel for her
blessings!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Смарт Фалкон eagerly grabs the raffle
machine's
lever...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Okay, star power! Time to shine! ☆
Yah! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
And she spins it! A small plastic ball
drops from
the tumbler's opening...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a
grand-prize
winner! Come and get the
coupon for your hot
spring vacation!
Congratulations!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Вы получили:
<itemname>
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I... DID IT! ☆☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Trainer! Did you see?!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: That's what a real Umadol's capable of!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Thank you! ☆ See? My Umadol power is
real!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, that just made my day. ♪ Anyway,
should
we head home?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Excuse me! Don't forget your prize!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text: Ah.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: A hot spring vacation coupon...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm super happy, but... when
should we go?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I only just made that declaration that I'll
take first
place in every race...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
It'll have to be after all my races are
finished, I
guess.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
choice_data_list: Then you can save it to use as a final reward.

text_block_list.text: Yeah, I guess that's the best...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Hold on a sec! Why are you talking like
it's got
nothing to do with you? You're
coming with me,
you know!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
If it's a reward for all our hard work, then
you'll
need it just as much!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
We're working towards the same dream,
aren't
we? We're in this together! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Besides, if we go once all this is over, I'll

definitely already be a top Umadol.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
And a top Umadol needs a bodyguard
even in her
off time, right?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
choice_data_list: So that's why you want me there.

text_block_list.text: ...Ehe, I guess you got me. ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Geez, you're so dense...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Nothing! ☆ I'm really looking forward to
our hot
spring getaway!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Looks like we have another first-prize
winner!
Congratulations! You get one
deluxe carrot
hamburger steak!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Вы получили:
<itemname>
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Yay! First prize. ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: It's not the grand prize... But still!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: First prize is the same as first place! And the deluxe hamburger steak has deluxe in the name!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: In other words... my Umadol power is deluxe!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: That makes sense, right?!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Yaaay! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Tonight's dinner is gonna be super
special! I
hereby invite you to the Falco
Dinner Show! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
We got a second-prize winner! It's your
lucky day!
You're going home with a
bushel of carrots!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Вы получили:
<itemname>
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Awww...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Aw!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Awww yeeeah! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Anyways...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Wow! Look at all these carrots! ☆ How
can I
possibly eat them all? ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
choice_data_list:
(She's just going to pretend that didn't
happen?!)

text_block_list.text: I know! This should be enough to...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Hi, everyooone! ☆ It's me, Falco!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Today's street performance has a special
bonus!
Everyone who came to watch...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Gets one carrot! ☆ Hand delivered by
yours
truly! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: A carrot...
text_block_list.name: Go-Getter Umamusume S

text_block_list.text: A carrot...
text_block_list.name: Silver-haired Umamusume O

text_block_list.text:
I hope you'll stay until the very end!
Let's make it
a good one!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Would you lookie here! You've won the
third
prize! Here's your carrot!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Вы получили:
<itemname>
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
There's something really important to me
as an
Umadol.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
And that is... being free to sing and
dance
anywhere and anytime my fans
desire!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: That's why winning this carrot—or should I say this carrot microphone...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Winning this carrot microphone means...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I've been acknowledged as a wonderful
Umadol!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Stardom Goddess! I'm gonna
do my
best to live up to your
expectations!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Twinkle... ☆
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled
a blank
one! Take this pack of tissues as
a consolation
prize.
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Вы получили:
<itemname>
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I didn't lose!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Losing a raffle isn't a real loss! So I'm still
full of
endless potential!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: I am... right? I've gotta be...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Or what... Is this all my star power is
worth? A
pack of tissues?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Juuuust kidding! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
A tissue is totally fine with me! If you
have
enough tissues, you can build a
mountain!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: That's why... Aha... haha...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
As if in response to Смарт Фалкон's
words, the
stars peeking through the
sunset appear to
twinkle.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She's putting on a brave face, but Smart
Falcon's
smile seems more than a little
forced.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
So in the end, I wind up holding on to
our
vacation coupon for the time being.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I enjoy a luxurious dinner that evening,
while
listening to a delighted Smart
Falcon sing.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It could just be my imagination, but
today's
audience seems a little larger
than usual when all
is said and done.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
